# HTMLRadar

HTMLRadar is read tracking for HTML documents. Upload an HTML file or paste
a public URL, send the tracked link instead of the original file, and see
who opened it, which sections they read, and how long they spent on each
one. Built for decks, briefs, and proposals shared as HTML rather than PDF.

Open source (AGPL-3.0), self-hostable on your own Cloudflare and Supabase
accounts. Free for two tracked links; paid plans start at $15/month.

## Key pages

- https://htmlradar.com/ — product overview and how it works

- https://htmlradar.com/mcp — MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex

- https://htmlradar.com/compare/docsend — HTMLRadar vs DocSend
